description: Worldsemi WS2812B-2020 — 2×2 mm addressable RGB LED in the smallest standard package. WS2812 protocol-compatible. Use when board area is tight and dense pixel arrays matter (POV displays, jewelry, fine wearable strips).
name: ws2812b-2020
watch_out_for: 2×2 mm pads — hand-soldering is hard; design assuming reflow or hot-air. Same 5 V supply and 800 kbps protocol as full-size WS2812B. Tighter brightness/thermal margins; spread high-density strings across the PCB to avoid hotspots.
